promotions.description: PADB offers an expedited account opening process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard applications where no additional documents or information are required. This digital onboarding service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. The quick account opening process features no minimum balance requirement.

promotions.title: Account Opening in 3 Minutes with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Open an account in as fast as 3 minutes with no minimum balance
promotions.description: PADB offers streamlined account opening that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard cases where no additional information or documents are required. The service has no minimum balance requirement and is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. Actual account opening time may vary depending on individual circumstances.
promotions.quota: Available to Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: 24/7 Full Banking Services on Mobile App
promotions.highlight: 🏦 Access complete banking services 24/7 through a single mobile app
promotions.description: PADB provides round-the-clock access to comprehensive banking services through its mobile application. Customers can manage deposits, transfers, cross-border payments, and foreign exchange transactions at any time without hassle. The service is designed to eliminate the need for queues, paper forms, and waiting, offering full banking capabilities in one convenient platform.

promotions.title: Zero Subscription and Redemption Fees for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Invest in money market funds with zero subscription and redemption fees
promotions.description: PADB offers HKD and USD money market funds with no subscription or redemption fees. Investors can start with as little as USD 20 for USD-denominated funds, with potential for steady returns (example: USD funds averaged 4.14% annual return based on data as of December 31, 2025). Redemptions can be processed as quickly as same-day to your bank account, providing excellent liquidity.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 20 depending on fund currency; zero transaction fees

promotions.title: Free Real-time Level 1 Market Data for Hong Kong Stocks
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero platform fees and real-time market data
promotions.description: PADB offers Hong Kong stock trading with no platform fees and includes free Level 1 real-time market data. Customers pay only 0.15% commission with a minimum fee of HKD 50 per trade. The service includes real-time market indices, industry trend analysis, and stock performance tracking tools to help investors make informed decisions.
promotions.quota: All PADB investment account holders with stock trading enabled
promotions.cost: 0.15% commission with minimum HKD 50 per trade; no platform fees

promotions.title: 16-Hour US Stock Trading with Advanced Analytics
promotions.highlight: 📊 Trade US stocks across a 16-hour window with professional analysis tools
promotions.description: PADB offers extended US stock trading capabilities with a comprehensive 16-hour trading window, covering pre-market, regular market, and after-hours sessions. Customers can leverage advanced analytics and professional market data to make informed investment decisions. The service provides flexibility for trading across different time zones, allowing Hong Kong-based investors to participate in the US market during local hours.
promotions.quota: All PADB investment account holders with US stock trading enabled
promotions.cost: US stock trading fees apply: USD 0.012 per share with minimum USD 7.88 per trade

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Mixed and Equity Funds
promotions.highlight: 📊 Access mixed and equity funds with a competitive 1% subscription fee
promotions.description: PADB offers mixed and equity funds with a competitive subscription fee of just 1%, lower than typical market rates. These funds provide exposure to multiple asset classes including stocks, fixed income securities, and money market instruments. The platform features comprehensive fund selections from top global fund companies, organized into easy-to-navigate thematic rankings.

promotions.title: Same-Day Redemption for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Get your money market fund redemptions as fast as same day
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers a fast redemption service for money market funds with funds potentially arriving in your bank account on the same day. This provides customers with greater liquidity and flexibility when managing their investments.

promotions.title: US Stocks Trading with Competitive Commission
promotions.highlight: 💹 Competitive stock trading fees for HK and US markets
promotions.description: PADB offers competitive commission rates for stock trading with 0.15% commission for Hong Kong stocks (minimum HKD 50 per trade) and USD 0.012 per share for US stocks (minimum USD 7.88 per trade). Both HK and US stock trading services come with zero platform fees. Real-time Level 1 market data for Hong Kong stocks is provided free of charge to customers who have activated the stock investment service.
promotions.cost: HK stocks: 0.15% commission (min. HKD 50); US stocks: USD 0.012 per share (min. USD 7.88)

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Bond Funds
promotions.highlight: 🔽 Reduced subscription fees on investment funds
promotions.description: PADB offers discounted subscription fees for various types of funds. Money market funds come with no subscription fees, bond funds are available at a reduced subscription fee of 0.5%, while mixed and equity funds have a competitive subscription fee of 1%. This pricing structure makes investing in funds more accessible and cost-effective compared to traditional channels, which typically charge 2-3% for fund subscriptions.
promotions.cost: Money market funds: Free; Bond funds: 0.5%; Mixed and equity funds: 1%

promotions.title: Global Investment Access Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Access global markets with HK stocks, US stocks, funds and money market funds
promotions.description: PADB provides comprehensive global investment access through its integrated platform, featuring Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, and money market funds. The service allows customers to easily diversify their investments across different asset classes and global markets. Users benefit from a seamless experience switching between banking and investment functions, with all capabilities available in a single account.
promotions.cost: Free platform access; trading fees apply for specific investment products

promotions.title: Comprehensive Insurance Solutions
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Access diverse insurance products through an integrated mobile platform
promotions.description: PADB offers a comprehensive range of insurance products including life, savings, motor, home, and travel insurance through its integrated mobile app. Customers benefit from simple application processes and can receive one-to-one tailored advisory services for wealth and legacy planning. The digital-first approach eliminates overwhelming complexity while still providing complete protection solutions.
promotions.quota: Available to PADB customers eligible for insurance products
promotions.cost: Varies by insurance product and coverage selected

promotions.title: US Stocks Trading with Zero Platform Fee
promotions.highlight: 🔄 No platform fees for stock trading
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank does not charge any platform fees for both Hong Kong and US stock trading services. This helps reduce the overall cost of stock investments for customers.

promotions.title: Banking Services for Hong Kong Visitors
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available to visitors physically in Hong Kong
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers banking services to visitors who are physically present in Hong Kong. This allows non-residents to access banking services during their stay in the city.
promotions.quota: Only for visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Hong Kong Stock Trading Commission Rate

promotions.description: PADB offers Hong Kong stock trading with no platform fees, allowing investors to trade more cost-effectively. promotions.cost: 0.15% commission with minimum HKD 50 per trade; no platform fee

promotions.description: PADB will be performing system upgrades and maintenance from 1:30 AM to 6:30 AM on August 9, 2020 (Sunday). During this maintenance period, mobile banking services and customer service functions may be temporarily unavailable or limited. The upgrade is intended to enhance the bank's service capabilities for customers.
promotions.cost: No cost; temporary service interruption only

promotions.title: Time Deposits for Steady Growth
promotions.highlight: 📈 Earn reliable returns with time deposits for steady growth
promotions.description: PADB offers time deposit accounts designed to provide customers with steady and reliable growth on their funds. These deposits can be seamlessly managed alongside regular savings accounts, allowing for flexible financial planning. Customers can easily arrange their funds to earn interest through both demand and time deposits, helping to optimize returns on their savings.
promotions.cost: Deposit amount requirements may apply depending on specific time deposit products

promotions.title: Banking Security × Brokerage-Grade Trading Power
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Enjoy bank-level security with professional trading capabilities
promotions.description: PADB combines robust banking security with professional brokerage-grade trading capabilities in a dual-strength investment account. Customers can effortlessly switch between investments and deposits, enabling agile portfolio management in changing market conditions. The service provides diversification options and smooth execution without friction, allowing users to stay ahead of market changes.
promotions.cost: Free account access; trading fees apply for specific investment transactions

promotions.title: WeLab Money Plus Investment Service
promotions.highlight: 📈 Money market fund with returns up to 4.4% in the past year
promotions.description: WeLab Money Plus (WeLab 閒智寶) is a money market fund that offers returns similar to time deposits without locking up your money. Features same-day settlement for instructions submitted before the daily cut-off time.

promotions.title: Apple Products Subscribe+ Program
promotions.highlight: 📱 Special installment plan for Apple products
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a special installment program specifically for Apple products, allowing customers to purchase Apple devices and pay in monthly installments. This service is available as part of the bank's loan offerings.

promotions.title: Policy Loan Service
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Loans secured against insurance policy cash values
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers policy loans that allow customers to borrow against the cash value of their insurance policies. This provides a way to access liquidity while keeping insurance coverage intact.

promotions.title: Money Safe Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Secure savings feature for better financial management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Money Safe feature (智安存) provides a secure savings option for customers looking to protect and manage their funds. This feature helps customers save more effectively as part of the bank's comprehensive banking services.

promotions.title: Learn Now Pay Later Program
promotions.highlight: 🎓 Education financing with flexible payment options
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Learn Now Pay Later program offers financing options for education expenses. This allows customers to pay for courses or educational programs through installment payments rather than upfront lump sums.

promotions.title: Card Debt Consolidation Loan
promotions.highlight: 💳 Consolidate high-interest credit card debt at lower rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a specialized loan service for consolidating credit card debts. This allows customers to combine multiple high-interest credit card balances into a single loan with potentially lower interest rates and fixed monthly payments.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enhanced savings product with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoSave 2.0 is an upgraded savings product offering competitive interest rates. It's designed to help customers maximize their returns on deposits through the bank's digital platform.

promotions.title: Featured Funds Services with Over 170 Funds
promotions.highlight: 📊 Access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Featured Funds Service provides access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses. Customers can easily invest in popular mutual funds, dividend funds, bond funds and more with a simple interface showing trending investment ideas.
promotions.cost: Monthly platform fee of 0.1% based on fund holdings value

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Make global payments with competitive exchange rates using the Global Wallet Debit Card
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Global Wallet Debit Card allows customers to make international payments using funds from their WeLab Global Wallet. Users benefit from competitive exchange rates and seamless integration with the WeLab Bank app.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Higher Interest Rate
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy higher deposit interest rates through AI-powered technology
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 offers higher deposit interest rates than standard accounts by intelligently leveraging AI and technology. The service helps customers maximize their savings returns without complex requirements.

promotions.title: WeLab閒智寶
promotions.highlight: 📈 Money market fund with returns similar to time deposits
promotions.description: WeLab閒智寶 is a money market fund available through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services that aims to provide returns similar to time deposits without lock-in periods. It offered a one-year return of up to 4.4% as of March 31, 2026.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 📈 Higher deposit rates leveraging AI and technology
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers GoSave 2.0 time deposits with competitive interest rates. The service intelligently uses AI and technology to provide better deposit rates compared to traditional banks.

promotions.title: Tesla Customer Exclusive Personal Instalment Loan Offer
promotions.highlight: 💸 Flexible personal loans with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Personal Instalment Loans with competitive interest rates and flexible repayment terms. Customers can borrow funds for various purposes with a straightforward application process.

promotions.title: Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💼 Competitive time deposit rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank provides time deposit services with competitive interest rates. Customers can lock in their funds for a fixed period to earn guaranteed returns higher than standard savings accounts.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Fund Investment Amount
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start investing with as little as HKD 100 or USD 15
promotions.description: WeLab Bank allows customers to start investing in funds with a minimum amount of just HKD 100 or USD 15 (for Featured Fund Service). This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to beginners and those looking to start with small amounts.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 15

promotions.title: First-time Foreign Currency Exchange Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Instant local money transfers
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Faster Payment System (FPS) transfers allowing customers to send and receive money instantly within Hong Kong. This service is part of their core banking offering.

promotions.title: WeLab Fund Platform - Flat 0.1% Monthly Fee
promotions.highlight: 💰 Money market fund with same-day settlement
promotions.description: WeLab 閒智寶 is a money market fund theme in WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Service with same-day settlement. It offers returns comparable to time deposits without lock-in periods, with the top-performing fund showing a one-year return of up to 4.4%.
promotions.cost: Same-day settlement applies to orders submitted before 9AM HKT

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Time Deposit 4% p.a. Interest Rate
promotions.highlight: 💰 Time deposit with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 is WeLab Bank's time deposit offering that provides competitive interest rates for customer savings. It is mentioned as one of the core banking services offered by WeLab Bank.

promotions.title: Easter Lucky Draw & Cash Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Win from 300 prizes including HKD1,000 travel vouchers
promotions.description: Get lucky draw chances by making foreign currency exchanges and spending with WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card. Automatic entry with eligible transactions during the promotion period. The more you spend, the higher your chances to win.
promotions.quota: 300 prizes in total, must have at least one eligible card transaction per round to participate

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - Up to 3% Cashback on Overseas Spending
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to 3% cashback on overseas spending and up to 0.2% on local spending
promotions.description: Use WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card to make eligible transactions and receive up to 0.2% cashback on local spending and up to 3% on overseas spending. Cashback will be automatically credited to core account by May 31, 2026.
promotions.quota: Maximum HKD 50 or equivalent per eligible transaction

promotions.title: Trip.com Discount with WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Save up to HKD 500 on Trip.com bookings
promotions.description: Book flights and hotels on Trip.com using WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card and enter designated promo code to enjoy discounts of up to HKD 500. Limited quota available on a first-come, first-served basis.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 4% p.a. Time Deposit for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💵 Enjoy 4% p.a. interest rate on HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New customers using promo code 'WL5000' can enjoy 4% p.a. interest rate on 1-month HKD GoSave 2.0 time deposits. Interest calculation example: (HKD 80,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30) + (HKD 200,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30) = HKD 920.55.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Welcome Offer - 2-in-1 Welcome Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy up to HKD 5,000 cash rewards for new customers
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy a dual welcome offer including up to 4% p.a. time deposit rate and up to HKD 4,000 investment fund cash rewards. Use promo code 'WL5000' when opening an account to be eligible.
promotions.cost: Deposit and investment required for full rewards

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Enjoy $0 foreign currency transaction fees with supported currencies
promotions.description: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card offers $0 foreign currency transaction fees for 10 supported currencies including JPY, USD, CNY, AUD, GBP, EUR, SGD, CAD, CHF, and NZD. No markup on currency exchange when using the card overseas.

promotions.title: 50 Extra Lucky Draw Chances for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎲 New customers receive 50 additional lucky draw chances
promotions.description: New customers get 50 extra chances to participate in the lucky draw promotion when using Global Wallet Debit Card for overseas spending. This is in addition to the automatic entry and 3% cashback on overseas transactions.

promotions.title: 50 Extra Lucky Draw Chances for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎲 New customers get 50 extra lucky draw entries
promotions.description: New customers can receive 50 additional lucky draw chances for the Easter Lucky Draw promotion. Combined with overseas spending rebates, new customers can maximize their rewards when using the Global Wallet Debit Card.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank New Customer 2-in-1 Welcome Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy up to HKD 5,000 cash rewards with time deposit and investment
promotions.description: New customers who open an account with promo code 'WL5000' can enjoy dual welcome benefits: up to 4% p.a. time deposit interest rate and up to HKD 4,000 investment fund cash reward, totaling approximately HKD 5,000 in rewards.
promotions.cost: Requires time deposit placement and fund investment

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Referral Rewards for Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 800 for each successful Tesla loan referral
promotions.description: Customers can refer friends who are Tesla owners to apply for WeLab Bank personal instalment loan with promo code 'TESLA5' to enjoy the special 4.55% APR offer. For each successful referral, the referrer will receive HKD 800 cash reward.
promotions.quota: Up to 10 successful referrals per customer (maximum HKD 8,000 reward)

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Fund Subscription Fee Offer until 31 Jul 2026
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Zero subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap
promotions.description: From now until July 31, 2026, retail banking users who have activated investment fund trading services with ZA Bank can enjoy 0% fund subscription fee offers with no cap. This allows customers to invest their full amount without paying any subscription fees, maximizing the potential return on investment. The offer is available for all funds on the platform.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank retail customers who have activated investment fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank New Customer 20% p.a. HKD Time Deposit Offer (Deposit Condition)
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest rate on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred through the MGM program can receive a +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate boost coupon after meeting deposit requirements. When combined with the base interest rate, customers can enjoy a total of 20% p.a. interest on new funds. The maximum eligible deposit is HKD 20,000 when meeting the basic deposit condition, and increases to HKD 100,000 when meeting additional investment requirements.
promotions.quota: New ZA Bank customers referred through the MGM program who meet deposit requirements
promotions.cost: Minimum deposit of HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening

promotions.title: StockBack x ZA Card 1.5% Stock Rebate Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn stocks as rewards for everyday spending
promotions.description: ZA Bank's StockBack x ZA Card program allows customers to earn stock rewards rather than traditional points when spending with their ZA Card. Users can accumulate stocks through daily spending to build a personalized reward package. The card comes with no annual or hidden fees and supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient transactions.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders with a valid investment account
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction to qualify for StockBack

promotions.title: Year-Round Travel Offers with ZA Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Exclusive travel discounts for ZA Card holders
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers year-round travel promotions for ZA Card holders, providing special discounts on travel-related purchases. These offers cover various travel services and destinations, giving cardholders access to preferential rates throughout the year. The promotion aims to enhance the travel experience while providing savings for ZA Bank customers.
promotions.cost: Card spending on travel-related services required

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with 11 Currencies
promotions.highlight: 💱 Hold 11 different currencies in one account
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a multi-currency savings account that allows customers to hold 11 different currencies including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD, and CHF. This flexible account enables 24/7 currency exchange at preferred rates to help customers seize market opportunities and grow their wealth. The feature supports easy asset allocation across savings and time deposits.

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at 3,000+ Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Zero-fee cash withdrawals at 3,000+ Visa ATMs
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong using their ZA Card. This service provides convenient access to cash without incurring any withdrawal fees within Hong Kong. Please note that overseas cash withdrawals may incur handling fees.
promotions.cost: Free for Hong Kong withdrawals; fees apply for overseas withdrawals

promotions.title: Zero Platform Fee on Crypto Trading for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Zero platform fee on crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: From February 1 to June 30, 2026, new crypto trading customers at ZA Bank can enjoy zero platform fees for their first 90 days after activating the service. This offer applies to all crypto trading transactions executed within the initial 90-day period with no cap on the transaction amount. The crypto trading platform allows customers to trade 24/7 directly using HKD or USD deposits.
promotions.quota: New customers activating crypto trading services for the first time
promotions.cost: Free (zero platform fee) during the promotional period

promotions.title: Custom Card Number Selection for ZA Card
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Choose the last 6 digits of your ZA Card number
promotions.description: ZA Bank is the first bank in Hong Kong that allows customers to choose the last 6 digits that appear on their card face. This personalization feature is available for the Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card fully supports mobile payment options including Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient transactions.

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: Free Instant FPS Transfers and Payments
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Zero-fee instant transfers via FPS
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers free instant transfers using the Faster Payment System (FPS), along with card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay functionality all in one app. Customers can receive both HKD and CNY using just their mobile phone number via FPS. Additional features include a Frequent Payee section for quick transfers and Group Lai See functionality for sending red packets with one tap.

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 1,000 Spending Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 1,000 in spending rebates for new customers
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can earn HKD 1,000 in spending rebates when opening an account using the invitation code 'ZADT88' and completing specified spending conditions. The rebate applies to eligible purchases made with the ZA Card within the designated timeframe after account opening. This promotion provides new customers with immediate value on their everyday spending.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts using the specific invitation code ZADT88
promotions.cost: Must complete specified spending conditions (details provided upon registration)

promotions.title: PowerDraw Up to 200% Rebate + Million Dollar Prize Pool
promotions.highlight: 💰 Win up to 200% rebate and share HKD 1 million prize pool
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw to win up to 200% rebate on purchases. Additionally, customers receive MillionTix through PowerDraw for a chance to share in a prize pool of HKD 1 million. This promotion encourages spending with ZA Card to maximize chances of winning substantial cashback and prizes.
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card for eligible transactions

promotions.title: ZA Digital Insurance - Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as fast as 3 minutes using just a smartphone. The platform provides comprehensive coverage options including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS). The entire process from application to claims is handled digitally for maximum convenience.
promotions.cost: Varies by insurance plan and coverage selected

promotions.title: Stock Trading with Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Trade stocks with zero brokerage and custody fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers commission-free stock trading with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees are as low as USD 1.99 or HKD 18 per transaction, making it an affordable option for frequent traders. The service includes the StockBack program that allows customers to get stocks for free after successfully purchasing stocks.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank customers with investment accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as USD 1.99 or HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Payment Connect: Zero-Fee Cross-Border Transfers Between Hong Kong and Chinese Mainland
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Real-time, fee-free transfers between HK and mainland China
promotions.description: ZA Bank's Payment Connect service enables real-time money transfers between Hong Kong and Chinese Mainland with zero fees. This cross-border payment solution provides a convenient way for customers to move funds internationally without incurring transfer charges. The service is part of ZA Bank's comprehensive global transfer offerings.

promotions.title: New Customer HKD 2,026 Reward Package and 2.5% StockBack
promotions.highlight: 💰 New customers earn 2.5% stock rewards on first HKD 10,000 spending
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can enjoy enhanced 2.5% StockBack rewards on their first HKD 10,000 of eligible spending within 30 days of account opening. This combines the standard 1.5% stock rebate with an additional 1% bonus for new users. Customers must select the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan to qualify for this elevated stock reward rate on initial card spending.
promotions.quota: New users who have never held any ZA Bank products or services
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card and select StockBack reward plan

promotions.title: Customer Referral Rewards Program for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's referral program offers rewards across 9 promotional phases, with the top 20 referrers in each phase earning up to HKD 10,000 each. Additionally, for each successful referral who deposits at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account, referrers receive a cash reward. The promotion runs until May 27, 2026, and is open to both Hong Kong residents and visitors.

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.

The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors currently in Hong Kong. The efficient onboarding process is part of ZA Bank's core digital banking features designed to provide immediate access to banking services.

Winners can redeem stocks from the top 100 companies by market value in the US stock market, effectively getting stocks for free after successful purchases.

The program allows consolidation of multiple credit card debts with repayment periods up to 72 months.

promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 required to receive cash rewards; monthly handling fee applies based on loan amount

promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process
